label: Teltonika RUTX11
description: A 4G LTE Cat 6 router with four Gigabit ports (one WAN, three LAN) and dual-band 802.11ac Wave 2 Wi-Fi at up to 867 Mbps. The gigabit step up from the RUT950, with the same four-port faceplate.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTX11 datasheet v1.4: 1 x WAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps and 3 x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps, IEEE 802.3/802.3u/802.3az with auto MDI/MDIX; Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n/ac Wave 2 (Wi-Fi 5) dual band at up to 867 Mbps; 4G LTE Cat 6 (300 Mbps downlink class), which is why wwan0 is modelled at 300M rather than the 100M of the Cat 4 units.
